title: A Cold Day Doesn't Disprove Global Warming
description:
Weather is today's conditions; climate is the long-term average, which the WMO standardises over 30-year periods. A single cold day is one data point and doesn't disprove a warming trend.

Sources:
• NOAA JetStream: Climate vs weather: https://www.noaa.gov/jetstream/global/climate-vs-weather
• NOAA NCEI: WMO climate normals: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/wmo-climate-normals
